title: Angie's Vanilla: Refabricated
description: A comprehensive modpack that derives the Hermitcraft spirit with a few additional twists. This pack can be used as a Vanilla+ pack for connecting to vanilla multiplayer servers, or directly to an officially supported server.
body:
# Yet Another Vanilla+ Pack!

But this one is... _a little different._ Why? Trust me bro.

Have you ever been inspired by the Hermitcraft style SMPs but felt they were missing certain QoL features that kept the vanilla experience from being peak?

This pack seeks to remediate this issue by putting together all the mods that boost the cosmetic freshness of the Minecraft experience.

This version of my pack also includes some mechanical changes, meaning that vanilla servers will reject your connection (a lite version of the pack is being worked on to accompany this). The purpose of this pack is to deliver on an enhancement of the original survival experience. Some included mechanic mods:

- Mastercutter
- Healing Campfire
- Carry On
- Better Than mending
- Actually Harvest
- Falling Tree
- And More

This pack is still in Beta as I evaluate what mods work and what doesn't.
